name: stroke-cap-butt
description: A butt stroke end between two endpoint guides.
useCase: Choose a butt cap for an open vector stroke.
misuse: Label the control when the editing context is unclear.

16.reason: Two endpoint guides distinguish where the stroke stops or extends; the outlined sample leaves a clear inner gap.

24.reason: Wider spacing separates both guide pairs from the cap sample, with matched margins around the full control.
